limits: Synthetic fixed-root one-DoF native mechanism, no food, geometry, learned policy or biology claim; no causal attribution of full crow release discrepancy.

mechanism.bounded_row: Canonical row regularization and bounds reproduce saturated implicit velocity and torque with CCD disabled. This is a component result with fixed coefficients and no geometry.
mechanism.current_drive: Refresh clamps the pre-integration drive command, but ABA and contact inverse mass still add h*D+h*h*K to physical inertia plus armature. Saturated backward-Euler torque is therefore under-realized in this isolated native model.
mechanism.hybrid_stage: The native hybrid graph predicts and materializes q before endpoint contact/constraint impulses, then publishes q and post-impulse v. This ordering preserves position at instantaneous impact; endpoint motor impulse rows are not a drop-in smooth-force model. The prototype omits motors in free prediction and fails the predeclared q and constitutive gates.
mechanism.rejected_shortcut: Do not reintegrate all post-impact velocity across the completed CCD segment: it moves impact geometry and conflates endpoint impulses with forces acting throughout the segment.

remaining_production_requirements: Solve bounded motors in native free prediction with physical mass plus authored armature; refresh targets, controller scales, friction, torque-speed envelopes and limits from current state.
Rematerialize force integration and implicit terms for actual remaining/selected CCD durations, rather than reusing nominal-h acceleration.
Separate smooth motor impulse accumulation from instantaneous contact impulse response without double application or phantom implicit contact inertia.
Verify coupled articulated joints and actual geometric contact, active-set changes, checkpoint/reset and submission partition invariance.
Re-run real crow manipulation at unchanged mechanical and 5mm trajectory-convergence gates; measure end-to-end throughput before promotion.
